slides.headline: SPACEX JUST REACHED THE ISS FASTER THAN A LONDON FLIGHT

caption:
SpaceX now holds all 5 fastest U.S. launch-to-docking times at the International Space Station, including a new record of 7 hours 55 minutes.

No other U.S. rocket has touched the top 5 fastest trips to the space station. All 5 belong to SpaceX's Dragon, which set the latest record with Crew-13 on October 1: 7 hours 55 minutes, shorter than a plane ride from New York to London. An astronaut left Earth and was floating inside the station before you'd finished a single workday. Any future competitor doesn't just need to catch up. They need to break an under-8-hour barrier that didn't exist last week.

One private company now controls every fast lane in American human spaceflight. NASA has no crew vehicle of its own anywhere close to these times. If SpaceX walks away, there is no plan B.
